minutes.headline: Commission approved three projects, continued two tree-mitigation hearings to Oct 18, and discussed severe office staffing losses.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission heard several wetlands hearings: a negative determination for utility work at 274 Prospect St and a dock at 19 Cliffview Terrace, approval of a notice of intent at 899 Flat Hill Rd with a silt fence added, and approval of the 205 Sunset Lane deck relocation with four conditions (one dissent). Hearings at 38 Oak Ridge Rd and 6 Peninsula Dr were continued to Oct 18 for tree replacement changes. The chair also reported the loss of the interim administrator and land agent, and a certificate of compliance for 4 Townsend Harbor Rd was approved contingent on added certifying language.

what_happened.line: The Commission approved a notice of intent for a deck relocation at 205 Sunset Lane with four conditions, on a 4-1 vote with one member opposed.
Hearings at 38 Oak Ridge Rd and 6 Peninsula Dr were continued to October 18 so applicants can revise tree replacement and landscaping plans.
Negative determinations passed 4-0 for utility connections at 274 Prospect St and a rolling dock at 19 Cliffview Terrace.
A certificate of compliance for 4 Townsend Harbor Rd was approved 5-0, contingent on added certifying language in the engineer's letter.
The chair reported staffing and support losses; the Town is seeking temporary clerical help and part-time conservation administrator hours from adjacent towns.

why_it_matters: Residents with wetlands or tree-removal projects near water may face slower reviews, since commissioners tied a continuance to the thin office staff and the Town is seeking temporary help and part-time administrator hours from neighboring towns.
Homeowners waiting on a certificate of compliance, as the applicant at 4 Townsend Harbor Rd was, depend on the same office capacity to close out a project.
watch_next: October 18, 2023: continued hearings for 38 Oak Ridge Rd, 6 Peninsula Dr and 441 Townsend Harbor Rd return to the Commission.
